data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure and order with both parameters, case_name and statute_citation, named. It leaves out the new-tab and close-tab handling and the Enter keypress, and it uses a hard-coded example statute and navigates CourtListener through a menu. A builder would need to fill in these small details, but the spec is still concrete enough to automate.
